description:
Extend existing `benchbox compare` command to support running benchmarks
across multiple platforms, unifying SQL and DataFrame comparison.

Problem:
- Currently have: benchbox compare (result files only), benchbox compare-dataframes
- Adding compare-sql would create 3 comparison commands
- SQL and DataFrame comparisons share 80% of the same options
- User confusion about which command to use

Solution: Extend `benchbox compare` with --run mode:
- benchbox compare results/*.json                    # Existing: compare files
- benchbox compare --run -p duckdb -p clickhouse     # NEW: run & compare SQL
- benchbox compare --run -p polars-df -p pandas-df   # NEW: run & compare DataFrame
- benchbox compare --run --type sql -p duckdb -p sqlite  # Explicit type

Benefits:
- Single `compare` command (no new commands)
- Backwards compatible with existing file comparison
- Shared codebase for visualization, reporting
- Unified documentation
- Deprecate compare-dataframes (alias to compare --run --type dataframe)
